definitions.ask: After going back with ⌃O, should a new gg/G/<N>g jump discard the pages ahead of you?
definitions.why: ⌃O/⌃I stay a plain back/forward stack; ⌃O never revisits pages you backed away from

choices.label: Clear the pages ahead, like browser history and Vim's jumpoptions=stack
Move them behind you, like Vim's default jump list, so ⌃O revisits them
